injuries.name: Nathan MacKinnon
injuries.note: MacKinnon wouldn't be ready until mid-February if that timetable proves to be accurate. It can't be overstated how important MacKinnon is to the Avalanche. He finished each of the previous four regular seasons with over 110 points, and he was well on his way towards another elite campaign after scoring 10 goals and 30 points through 20 appearances. Brock Nelson and Nazem Kadri are serving as the Avalanche's top two centers while MacKinnon is unavailable.

injuries.name: Ivan Demidov
injuries.note: Demidov didn't begin the road trip with the team, but he'll meet up before the Canadiens visit the Golden Knights. His recovery appears to be close to wrapping up, but it's unclear if Demidov will be back in the lineup before the end of the current trip.

injuries.name: Mike Matheson
injuries.note: Matheson has already been out of action for the last six games due to his lower-body injury, so his move to LTIR will only cost him an additional four games, which he was likely to miss anyway based on his recovery timeline. With the available cap space, the Habs recalled Brett Berard and David Reinbacher from the minors.

injuries.name: Josh Anderson
injuries.note: The Canadiens moved Anderson to the injured reserve list Sunday after he logged a season-low 10:46 of ice time in Saturday's 4-1 loss to Colorado. He has contributed eight goals, 12 points, 35 shots on net and 42 hits in 19 appearances this season. With Anderson and Chris Kreider (lower body) dealing with long-term injuries, Florian Xhekaj and Owen Beck could see regular minutes in Montreal's bottom-six forward group.
